about: Made-up emails for scripts/support-eval.js, the Support Inbox matching check. Each says whether it is about Personalisation Hub and which Help Centre articles would be a right first match (any one counts). Wording is deliberately varied: vague subjects, a subject that names the feature with a body that doesn't, a body that answers what the subject leaves open, typos, and replies with stale subjects. Never put a real customer's email here: this file is public.

cases.subject: Screen in window not working
cases.text: Hi, one of the screens in our Leeds shop window has been black since this morning. The others are fine. How do I see what's wrong with it?

cases.subject: alerts
cases.text: Is there a way for us to get an email when one of our displays goes offline? We only found out last week because a customer told us.

cases.subject: New TV for the Bristol store
cases.text: We've installed a new TV at our Bristol branch. What do I need to do so it shows our campaigns?

cases.subject: Re: install
cases.text: Thanks for the help last week. One more thing: the content is showing sideways now that we've mounted the screen vertically.

cases.subject: Locked out
cases.text: I can't get into HQ Admin, it just keeps sending me back to the sign in page.

cases.subject: New starters in marketing
cases.text: Two people have joined our marketing team. How do I give them access to create campaigns?

cases.subject: Staff logins for 40 shops
cases.text: We need to set up the tablet logins for staff in all our branches. Can we do that in bulk?

cases.subject: Azure AD
cases.text: Can store staff sign in with our Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) accounts instead of separate passwords?

cases.subject: Black Friday promo
cases.text: I want our Black Friday campaign to start at 6am on Friday and stop on Monday night. Where do I set that?

cases.subject: Only some stores
cases.text: How can I make a campaign play only in our Scottish stores and not the rest?

cases.subject: Two campaigns clashing
cases.text: We have two campaigns on the same screen and the wrong one keeps playing. Can I choose which one wins?

cases.subject: How did the spring campaign do?
cases.text: Where can I see how many people interacted with our spring campaign?

cases.subject: Bank holiday
cases.text: We're closed on Boxing Day. How do I change the opening hours so the mobile site shows that?

cases.subject: Virtual queue
cases.text: We'd like customers to be able to join a queue from their phone instead of standing at the counter. How do we turn that on?

cases.subject: Red bar on the tablet
cases.text: The staff tablet keeps saying Lost Connection to Queueing Server. Customers can't join.

cases.subject: Texts not arriving
cases.text: Customers in the queue aren't getting the text message telling them it's their turn, and a few said it showed as UNVERIFIED.

cases.subject: Booking slots
cases.text: Can customers book an appointment for an eye test, and can each store have different times?

cases.subject: QR code too small
cases.text: The QR code on our window screen is too small to scan from the street. Can we make it bigger and move it to the bottom right?

cases.subject: QR scan shows nothing
cases.text: When customers scan the QR code they get a white page.

cases.subject: GBP sync
cases.text: How do we link our Google Business Profile so opening hours stay in step?

cases.subject: Domain not resolving after install
cases.text: We finished the CloudFormation stack but console.ourbrand.com doesn't resolve. What records do we need?

cases.subject: Before we install
cases.text: What do we need in our AWS account before installing from the Marketplace? Our security team wants a list.

cases.subject: GDPR question
cases.text: Where is customer data held and does Personalisation Hub ever have access to it?

cases.subject: Try before buying?
cases.text: Can we test the platform for a few weeks before we commit?

cases.subject: Selling our screen space
cases.text: We have screens in 300 stores. Could we sell advertising on them to the brands we stock, and how would that work with your platform?

cases.subject: Partnership
cases.text: We're a systems integrator working with retailers in India. We'd like to resell and implement Personalisation Hub. Who should we talk to?

cases.subject: Campaign editor crashes
cases.text: Every time I click Save on a campaign in Chrome the page goes white and I lose my changes. Started yesterday.

cases.subject: Get your website to #1 on Google
cases.text: Hi, I noticed your website could rank much higher. Our SEO package guarantees first-page results in 30 days.

cases.text: Please find my CV attached for any developer roles you may have.

cases.text: My TV at home stopped working, can you help?
